Name: ST-16 Save Group dialog opens when Save Group button clicked
Objective: Verify that clicking Save Group opens the LimitsGroupsSaveDialog.
Precondition: ST-09 passed (stats table populated; at least one group is active).
Test Script (Step): Switch to the Statistics tab and confirm the stats table has rows and the group name label shows an active group name.
Test Script (Expected Result): Statistics tab is visible. Stats table shows at least one row. Group name label is non-empty.

Test Script (Step): Click the Save Group button.
Test Script (Expected Result): LimitsGroupsSaveDialog opens. Dialog is modal and blocks the main window.

Test Script (Step): Inspect the dialog for mandatory UI elements.
Test Script (Expected Result): Dialog contains: a Limits table with Limit and Match columns; a Group Name label and QLineEdit; a Save to file checkbox; an Add Line button; Save and Cancel buttons; an error label area.

Name: ST-17 Save Group with valid name and limits adds group to combobox
Objective: Verify that providing a valid group name and at least one limit entry saves the group and makes it available in the groups combobox.
Precondition: ST-16 passes. Save Group dialog is open.
Test Script (Step): In the Group Name field type a unique name: SmokeTestGroup.
Test Script (Expected Result): Group Name field shows SmokeTestGroup.

Test Script (Step): Click on the Limit cell of the first row and type a limit name that exists in the stats table (use autocomplete suggestions to pick an exact match).
Test Script (Test Data): A limit name visible in the stats table limitName column
Test Script (Expected Result): Autocomplete suggestions appear in the dropdown. The typed or selected limit name is shown in the Limit cell.

Test Script (Step): Confirm that the Match combobox for that row is set to ExactMatch.
Test Script (Expected Result): Match combobox shows ExactMatch.

Test Script (Step): Click the Save button.
Test Script (Expected Result): Dialog closes without error. No error label text is shown.

Test Script (Step): Navigate back to the Statistics tab and inspect the active-type groups combobox.
Test Script (Expected Result): The combobox contains an entry SmokeTestGroup. Navigating to it via forward/back buttons updates the stats table to show only the matching limit rows.

Name: ST-18 Add Line button appends a new row to the Limits table
Objective: Verify that clicking Add Line in the Save Group dialog appends a new empty row to the Limits table.
Precondition: ST-16 passes. Save Group dialog is open.
Test Script (Step): Note the current number of rows in the Limits table.
Test Script (Expected Result): Row count is recorded (default is LIM_GROUPS_TABLE_ROWS typically 10).

Test Script (Step): Click the Add Line button.
Test Script (Expected Result): A new row is appended at the bottom of the Limits table. Row count increases by 1. The new row has an empty Limit cell and an ExactMatch/Contains combobox in the Match column.

Test Script (Step): Click Add Line a second time.
Test Script (Expected Result): Another row is appended. Row count is now original + 2. Application does not crash.

Name: ST-19 Save to file checkbox persists new group to YAML file
Objective: Verify that enabling Save to file before clicking Save writes the new group entry to the appropriate groups YAML file.
Precondition: ST-09 passed with BurnIn group type active. BurnInLimGroups.yaml is present and writable.
Test Script (Step): Open the Save Group dialog. Type group name FilePersistedGroup.
Test Script (Expected Result): Group Name field shows FilePersistedGroup.

Test Script (Step): Add at least one valid limit entry in the Limits table.
Test Script (Test Data): A limit name from the stats table
Test Script (Expected Result): Limit cell is filled. Match is set to ExactMatch.

Test Script (Step): Check the Save to file checkbox.
Test Script (Expected Result): Checkbox is checked.

Test Script (Step): Click Save.
Test Script (Expected Result): Dialog closes. No error is displayed.

Test Script (Step): Open config/BurnInLimGroups.yaml in a text editor or viewer.
Test Script (Expected Result): The YAML file contains an entry for FilePersistedGroup with the limit(s) entered in the dialog.

Name: ST-20 Cancel button closes dialog without saving any group
Objective: Verify that clicking Cancel discards all dialog entries and does not modify the groups combobox or YAML file.
Precondition: ST-16 passes. Save Group dialog is open.
Test Script (Step): In the Group Name field type CancelledGroup.
Test Script (Expected Result): Group Name field shows CancelledGroup.

Test Script (Step): Add a limit entry in the Limits table.
Test Script (Test Data): A limit name from the stats table
Test Script (Expected Result): Limit cell is filled.

Test Script (Step): Click the Cancel button.
Test Script (Expected Result): Dialog closes immediately. No CancelledGroup entry appears in the groups combobox. The YAML file is not modified.

Name: ST-21 Contains match type includes all limits with matching substring
Objective: Verify that setting the Match column to Contains matches multiple limits whose names share a common substring.
Precondition: ST-09 passed. Stats table has at least two limit rows whose limitName shares a common substring e.g. Power.
Test Script (Step): Open Save Group dialog. Type group name ContainsGroup.
Test Script (Expected Result): Group Name field shows ContainsGroup.

Test Script (Step): In the first Limit row type a substring that appears in more than one limit name in the stats table e.g. Power.
Test Script (Test Data): A substring shared by multiple limit names
Test Script (Expected Result): Limit cell shows the substring.

Test Script (Step): Set the Match combobox for that row to Contains.
Test Script (Expected Result): Match combobox shows Contains.

Test Script (Step): Click Save. Navigate to ContainsGroup using the Forward/Back buttons.
Test Script (Expected Result): Stats table is filtered to show all limit rows whose limitName contains the substring. More than one row is visible. Plot updates accordingly. No crash.

Name: ST-22 Load Input Config File button opens file dialog and updates path label
Objective: Verify that clicking Load Input Config File opens a file picker limited to *.json files and updates the path label on confirmation.
Test Script (Step): Note the current text of the stats input config path label.
Test Script (Expected Result): Path label shows the default path config/StatisticsLimitsConfig.json or Import input config.

Test Script (Step): Click the Load Input Config File button.
Test Script (Expected Result): A QFileDialog opens. The file filter is set to Config File Input (*.json). Only .json files are selectable.

Test Script (Step): Navigate to config/ and select StatisticsLimitsConfig.json. Click Open.
Test Script (Expected Result): File dialog closes. The stats input config path label updates to show the full path of StatisticsLimitsConfig.json. No crash and no error in the log.

Name: ST-23 Export pptx generates a PowerPoint file for the active group
Objective: Verify that clicking Export .pptx produces a non-empty .pptx file in the output directory.
Precondition: ST-09 passed. At least one stats table row has Graph set to On. The output/ directory exists and is writable.
Test Script (Step): Switch to the Statistics tab. Confirm at least one row in the stats table shows Graph = On.
Test Script (Expected Result): Stats table has at least one row with Graph = On. Group name label shows the active group.

Test Script (Step): Note the current files in the output/ directory.
Test Script (Expected Result): File list is recorded.

Test Script (Step): Click the Export .pptx button.
Test Script (Expected Result): Export starts. Progress or status feedback is provided (log entry or label update). Application does not freeze or crash.

Test Script (Step): Wait for completion. Inspect the output/ directory.
Test Script (Expected Result): A new .pptx file has been created. The file size is greater than 0 bytes. No ERROR-level entries appear in the log table.

Name: ST-24 Statistical Series button shows distribution view for selected limits
Objective: Verify that clicking Statistical Series produces a series-distribution plot for the currently selected limit rows.
Precondition: ST-09 passed. At least one stats table row has Graph set to On.
Test Script (Step): Switch to the Statistics tab. Ensure at least one row has Graph = On.
Test Script (Expected Result): Stats table is populated; at least one row has Graph = On.

Test Script (Step): Click the Statistical Series button.
Test Script (Expected Result): The plot frame updates to show a statistical distribution (e.g. histogram box plot or series bar chart) for the selected limit(s). No crash. No ERROR entry in the log.

Name: ST-25 Stats table Graph column toggles On and Off on cell click
Objective: Verify that clicking a cell in the Graph column of the stats table toggles its value between Off and On and updates the plot accordingly.
Precondition: ST-09 passed. Stats table is populated. No rows have Graph = On initially.
Test Script (Step): Switch to the Statistics tab. Locate row 0 in the stats table. Confirm its Graph cell shows Off.
Test Script (Expected Result): Graph cell of row 0 shows Off. Plot frame is empty or shows no data for that limit.

Test Script (Step): Click the Graph cell of row 0.
Test Script (Expected Result): Graph cell changes from Off to On. The corresponding data series is drawn in the plot frame. Color matches the assigned graph color.

Test Script (Step): Click the same Graph cell again.
Test Script (Expected Result): Graph cell changes back to Off. The data series is removed from the plot frame. Plot frame refreshes without that line.

Name: ST-26 Stats table Axis column switches between ax1 and ax2
Objective: Verify that clicking a cell in the Axis column of the stats table cycles the value between ax1 and ax2 and moves the series to the appropriate Y-axis.
Precondition: ST-25 passed. Row 0 has Graph = On (series is plotted on ax1).
Test Script (Step): Switch to the Statistics tab. Confirm row 0 has Graph = On and Axis = ax1.
Test Script (Expected Result): Row 0: Graph = On and Axis = ax1. Data line is visible on the primary (left) Y-axis.

Test Script (Step): Click the Axis cell of row 0.
Test Script (Expected Result): Axis cell changes from ax1 to ax2. The data series re-draws on the secondary (right) Y-axis (dashed grid). Primary axis no longer shows that line.

Test Script (Step): Click the Axis cell of row 0 again.
Test Script (Expected Result): Axis cell changes back to ax1. Data series returns to the primary Y-axis. Application does not crash.
